commands: set -euo pipefail; C=$HOME/agent-workspace/control; echo '=== STATUS ==='; git -C $C status -sb; echo '=== BRANCH CONFIG ==='; git -C $C config --get-all branch.agent-control.remote || true; git -C $C config --get-all branch.agent-control.merge || true; git -C $C config --get-all branch.agent-control.rebase || true; echo '=== FETCH CONFIG ==='; git -C $C config --get-all remote.origin.fetch || true; echo '=== FETCH_HEAD ==='; cat $C/.git/FETCH_HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== REFS ==='; git -C $C for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads refs/remotes; echo '=== CONTROL SIZE ==='; du -sh $C $C/.git; git -C $C rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; git -C $C config --get remote.origin.promisor
